in_sanskrit.name: अमित्रजित्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is never defeated by enemies

in_marathi.name: Amitrajit
in_marathi.long_meaning: Amitrajit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from two words - Amitra (unconquerable) and Jit (lord).
